narr: As an area of high pressure remained centered east of New Mexico, deep monsoonal moisture continued to surge into northern and central New Mexico on June 26, 2022. An embedded easterly wave helped in the development and intensification of numerous thunderstorms during the afternoon and evening hours. Northeast Roswell was hit hardest as thunderstorms with heavy rainfall rates caused flash flooding across portions of the city. A blocked drainage gate was responsible for flooding at least a dozen homes in the Holly Loop subdivision, and elsewhere in Roswell, an overflowing Borrendo Creek caused a bridge to collapse.
ev: Over three inches of rain in Roswell caused significant flooding on the northeast side of the city. At least twelve homes in the Holly Loop subdividion were flooded, and emergency crews had to divert water through cinder block walls away from the subdivision and onto East Country Club Road. Farther east, a small bridge collapsed at East Mescalero Road near La Jara Road due to flood waters in Borrendo Creek. Damages are estimated.
